Title: Sign in with a valid password

Steps (Step): Enter the e-mail address and the password

Title: Sign in with a wrong password
Steps (Step): Enter a wrong password and press Sign in
Steps (Expected Result): An error message is shown and no session is created
The account is locked for 15 minutes

Title: Add an item to the cart
Steps (Step):
1. Open a product page
2. Press Add to cart
Steps (Expected Result):
1. The product page is shown
2. The cart shows one item

Title: Pay with a saved card
Steps (Step): Choose the saved card and pay
